visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: On and Off Toggle Button
visualizerParams.description: Type a button that switches between On and Off and tells assistive technology its state with aria-pressed. The attribute must always match what the button shows.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<button id="sw" aria-pressed="false">Off</button>
<script>
  var sw = document.getElementById('sw');
  sw.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var on = sw.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true';
    sw.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on);
    sw.textContent = on ? 'On' : 'Off';
  });
</script>

checks.label: A second click turns it Off
